description: Read the internal sequencer state: running, current pattern and step, BPM, muted tracks, pattern queue, patterns defined. Use it to answer 'Was läuft gerade?' before speaking about state.
name: get_sequencer_status

description: Start the internal sequencer looping a pattern. Omit pattern and bpm to use the loaded song's first pattern and tempo. Stops the device transport first if it is running.
name: start_sequencer

pattern.description: pattern name; default: first pattern of the song

bpm.description: tempo; default: the loaded song's tempo

description: Stop the internal sequencer immediately (all notes off).
name: stop_sequencer

description: Change the internal sequencer tempo while it plays. For 'schneller'/'langsamer' without a number, change by about 5 BPM ('viel' 15) from the current BPM.
name: set_bpm

description: Mute or unmute one track: synth1, synth2, drum1..drum4, midi1, midi2. 'Drums' or 'Schlagzeug' means all four drum tracks (call once per track). muted=false unmutes. Works for the internal sequencer and, via levels, for a project playing on the device.
name: mute_track

description: Queue patterns to play after the current one, in order (song structure by voice).
name: queue_patterns

description: Replace the whole pattern queue with this ordered list of patterns.
name: set_song

description: Clear the pattern queue so the current pattern loops.
name: clear_queue

description: List the pattern names of the loaded song.
name: list_patterns

description: Set synth parameters on synth 1 or 2 while playing. Raw patch parameters (0-127), the base values under the macro knobs; for filter, resonance and envelopes prefer set_macro. Common: filter_frequency, filter_resonance, osc1_wave/osc2_wave, osc1_level/osc2_level, osc1_semitones/osc2_semitones (64 = no shift), env1_attack/env1_decay/env1_sustain/env1_release (Lautstärke-Hüllkurve; 'mehr Release' = env1_release), env2_attack/env2_decay/env2_sustain/env2_release (Filter-Hüllkurve), env2_to_filter_freq, lfo1_rate/lfo1_waveform, distortion_level, chorus_level, portamento_rate, polyphony_mode (0 = mono, 2 = polyphon; chords need 2). Without a number, move about 20 steps ('etwas' 10, 'viel' 40).
name: set_synth_params

description: Set drum parameters on drum 1-4 (0-127): level (leiser/lauter), pitch, decay, distortion, eq, pan. eq is a tilt: 0 = only lows pass (dumpf, mehr Bass), 64 = flat, 127 = only highs (hell, dünn).
name: set_drum_params

description: Set project-wide parameters (0-127): reverb_synth1_send/reverb_synth2_send/reverb_drum1_send.. (Hall), delay_*_send (Echo/Delay), synth1_level/synth2_level/synth1_pan/synth2_pan (Mixer), master_filter_frequency/master_filter_resonance, reverb_decay, delay_time, delay_feedback.
name: set_project_params

description: Turn one of the device's eight macro knobs (1-8) on synth 1 or 2 to 0-127; this is what the patches on the device respond to. Usual layout: 1=Oscillator 2=OscMod 3=AmpEnv 4=FilterEnv 5=Filter (Cutoff: 'Filter auf' = higher, 'zu' = lower) 6=Resonance 7=Modulation 8=FX. Prefer this over set_synth_params for filter, resonance and envelope requests unless the user names a raw parameter.
name: set_macro

description: Select a synth patch on synth 1 or 2 by its number as shown on the device (1-64) or by its name (needs the names read in once with scan_patches).
name: select_patch

description: The patch names on the device with their numbers, optionally filtered by a word ('bass'). Always try this first; it says when the names still need scan_patches.
name: list_patches

description: Read the names of all 64 patches from the device (a few seconds, only while nothing plays; the selected patch changes during the scan and is restored). Only after list_patches said the names are unknown.
name: scan_patches

description: Audition notes: play MIDI notes on channel 0 (synth 1) or 1 (synth 2) for duration_ms.
name: play_notes

description: Audition one drum hit (drum 1-4).
name: play_drum

description: Read the current patch of synth 1 or 2 from the device (name and parameters). Slow: a SysEx round trip.
name: get_synth_patch

description: Start an empty song: one 32-step pattern ('pattern1'), lead on synth1 and bass on synth2. The scale is C minor like a fresh device project; notes outside it move to the nearest scale note. Use it when the user wants to build from nothing ('Neuer Song', 'fang neu an').
name: new_song

description: Put exact notes or chords on a synth track. notes is an array with one entry per step: a note name the device uses (C3 = middle, F#4, Bb2, German H) or a MIDI number, or an array of notes for a chord, e.g. [["E3","G3","B3"], "E3"] = E minor chord, then a single E. The synths play up to six notes at once. A rest is an empty string "": it keeps its place ('C3 C3 leer leer C4' = ["C3","C3","","","C4"]). spacing = steps between entries (4 = every beat, 2 = eighths, 1 = every step), start_step is spoken 1-based; without it the notes are appended after the last one. gate defaults to the spacing. A note held 'für 12 Schritte' or 'lang' is ONE entry with gate 12 (max 16) and spacing 12, not 12 repeated entries. replace=true clears the track first.
name: write_notes

pattern.description: pattern name; default: the pattern last worked on

notes.description: one entry per step; an entry is one note or an array of notes (chord)

description: Put drum hits on exact steps (spoken 1-based, 1-32) of drum1..drum4, e.g. four-on-the-floor kick = [1, 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25, 29]. Patterns have 32 steps (two bars): always fill both bars. Adds to existing hits unless replace=true.
name: write_drums

velocities.description: per-hit velocities in step order, cycled when shorter ([110, 70] = accents)

description: Change one existing step of a track: its velocity, notes (synth; one note or a chord) or gate, e.g. 'Schritt 5 lauter', 'auf Schritt 5 einen C-Dur-Akkord'. Spoken 1-based step.
name: set_step

notes.description: the notes sounding on this step: one note, or several for a chord

description: The drum samples on the device by number and name (64 per page of the bank, page 1-4).
name: list_drum_samples

description: Add a pattern to the song ('zweites Pattern', 'neues Pattern', 'noch ein Teil'). Without a name it becomes pattern2, pattern3, ... copy_from = an existing pattern to start from ('eine Kopie', 'eine Variation'); without it the new pattern is empty. If the user did not say which, ask once: leer oder als Kopie? The new pattern is appended to the song order, later edits without a pattern name go to it, and a running sequencer switches to it when the current pattern ends. To go back, pass pattern= to the edit tools or use queue_patterns.
name: add_pattern

description: Choose the sample (1-64, by number or by a word from its name such as 'Snare') for drum 1-4. The device cannot switch samples live over MIDI, so it is stored in the song and audible after saving to the device and playing the project from there. Says so.
name: set_drum_sample

description: Remove every note or hit from one track of a pattern.
name: clear_track

description: List the saved songs the user can load by name ('Welche Songs gibt es?').
name: list_saved_songs

description: Load a saved song by its spoken name into the internal sequencer (does not start playback).
name: load_saved_song

description: Save the loaded song into a project slot (1-64) on the Circuit Tracks, overwriting that slot. Call it first without confirmed; it returns the German question to ask. After the user says yes, call it again with confirmed=true. name defaults to the song name (max 16 characters). Without slot ('hier', 'im aktuellen Slot') it takes the project selected on the device, else the slot of the last save.
name: save_to_device

description: Start, stop or continue the project playing on the Circuit Tracks itself (its own patterns, our MIDI clock). Stops the internal sequencer first if it runs. bpm is optional; the device's project tempo is used otherwise.
name: transport

description: Change the tempo (20-300 BPM) while the device plays from our clock. For the internal sequencer use set_bpm instead.
name: set_tempo

description: Select a project stored on the device by its number (1-64). While playing it switches at the end of the pattern unless immediate=true. Returns a German question when sounds were changed since the last project select; ask the user and call again with confirmed=true after a clear yes.
name: select_project

description: Read a project (1-64) from the device into the internal sequencer as a song, so it can be revised and saved again. Slow (SysEx).
name: import_project

description: Have a musical idea written for ONE track by a text model (a few seconds): 'groovige Bassline auf Synth 2', 'Hi-Hat-Pattern mit Offbeats auf drum3'. Replaces that track only. Without confirmed it returns how long it takes and the question to ask; after a clear yes call again with confirmed=true.
name: generate_track

description: Design a new synth sound from a description ('warmer, weicher Bass mit langsamem Filter') and load it into synth 1 or 2 (working memory, not saved). Without confirmed it returns the question to ask first; after a clear yes call again with confirmed=true.
name: design_patch

description: Save the current sound of synth 1 or 2 into a patch slot (1-64) on the device, overwriting it. Call first without confirmed to get the question; after a clear yes call again with confirmed=true.
name: save_patch

description: Build a new song from a German brief (style, tempo, key, mood, instruments). Runs in the background for about half a minute. Without confirmed it returns the question to ask first. Replaces the loaded song.
name: compose

description: Change the loaded song by instruction ('Hi-Hats leiser', 'Bassline auf Synth 2 dazu', 'Chorus doppelt so lang'). Slow (half a minute or more). Without confirmed it returns the question to ask first.
name: revise

description: Sweep synth parameters over time ('Filter langsam von zu nach auf', 'in Bewegung bringen'): start and target values per parameter, duration in bars, optional ping_pong to go back and forth. Runs in the background until stop_morph.
name: morph_synth_params

description: Sweep drum parameters (level, pitch, decay, ...) over time for drum 1-4; same shape as morph_synth_params.
name: morph_drum_params

description: Sweep project parameters (reverb/delay sends, mixer, master filter) over time; same shape as morph_synth_params.
name: morph_project_params

description: Stop running parameter sweeps (all, by name, or by synth).
name: stop_morph

description: Remove every step from every track of a pattern ('Pattern eins leeren').
name: clear_pattern

description: The steps of a pattern per track, to answer 'Was liegt auf Synth eins?'.
name: get_pattern

description: What the agent knows: playback source, loaded song, tempo, mutes, unsaved changes, last change. Cheap; never touches the device. Only when the user asks about the state, never before a change.
name: get_state

description: Revert the last parameter, tempo or mute change ('Rückgängig'). Says when nothing can be undone.
name: undo_last

description: Switch how the agent listens: 'ptt' (hold the key), 'toggle' (press to start and stop), 'open' (always listening, headphones recommended).
name: set_listening
